title: Physics Laboratory I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rigid body capable of oscillating freely about a horizontal axis passing through it."
A compound pendulum is a rigid body capable of oscillating freely about a horizontal axis passing through it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used as voltage regulators and as voltage reference standards."
Zener diodes are used as voltage regulators and as voltage reference standards.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a material whose electrical conductivity lies between that of a metal and an insulator."
A semi-conductor is a material whose electrical conductivity lies between that of a metal and an insulator.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the distance between the axis of rotation and the point at which the whole mass of the body could be considered to be placed without any change in its moment of inertia about that axis."

The radius of gyration is defined as the distance between the axis of rotation and the point at which the whole mass of the body could be considered to be placed without any change in its moment of inertia about that axis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ratio of possible error to total measurement."
Relative error is the ratio of possible error to total measurement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special kind of p-n junction diode."
Zener diode is a special kind of p-n junction diode.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of possible error only."
Precision is a function of possible error only.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used as shock absorbers in automobiles and railway wagons."
Springs are used as shock absorbers in automobiles and railway wagons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known, n may be computed if you measure the length of the wire and its radius."
Once tk is known, n may be computed if you measure the length of the wire and its radius.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a beam fixed horizontally at one end."
A Cantilever is a beam fixed horizontally at one end.

beam
A beam is a bar of uniform cross-section (circular or rectangular) of a homogeneous, isotropic (which have the same properties at all points and in all directions) elastic material.

reaction time

transistor

CE configuration
The CE configuration is used most widely because it provides voltage, current and power gain.

'common' terminal
The 'common' terminal is the positive end of the battery, whereas the ( VA) terminal is its negative end.
______ is the straight portion of the parabola.
straight line actually
The straight line actually is the straight portion of the parabola.

precision index S
The precision index S is a measure of uncertainty of average.

vertical scale
The vertical scale is a logarithmic scale (it automatically takes logarithms of data plotted), in which each power of ten or decade (also called frequency) corresponds to the same length of scale.
